findings.title: Global canManage() grants manage on VIEW scope
findings.body: File GroupPermissionsV2.java canManage() returns hasPermission(null, VIEW, MANAGE). This means an admin with only the view scope on all-groups passes requireManage(), which guards POST /groups (addTopLevelGroup), addChild and group updates. View permission must not imply manage/create; per-group canManage(GroupModel) correctly checks only MANAGE. Consequence is privilege escalation: read-only group viewers can create and modify groups.

findings.title: getGroupIdsWithViewPermission uses authz resource id instead of group id
findings.body: File GroupPermissionsV2.java getGroupIdsWithViewPermission() iterates V2 group resources and calls hasPermission(groupResource.getId(), ...) then granted.add(groupResource.getId()). hasPermission(String) expects a Keycloak group id and does resourceStore.findByName(server, groupId), so passing the internal authorization resource UUID misses and falls back to the all-groups resource for every iteration. The set is also populated with internal resource UUIDs, but callers in UsersResource/BruteForceUsersResource put the set into session attribute UserModel.GROUPS and getUsersCount(..., groupIds), which expect Keycloak group ids. Consequence is broken member filtering: counts return 0 and search pre-filtering with wrong ids, inconsistent with per-user canView filtering.

findings.title: Missing null check for all-groups type resource causes NPE
findings.body: File GroupPermissionsV2.java hasPermission() does resource = SCHEMA.getResourceTypeResource(session, server, GROUPS_RESOURCE_TYPE) when the specific group resource is absent, then unconditionally calls policyStore.findByResource(server, resource). getResourceTypeResource() can return null if the type resource was never created (e.g. upgraded realm, disabled schema). Passing null resource causes NullPointerException or store failure, denying all group evaluations. Same pattern exists in UserPermissionsV2.java for USERS_RESOURCE_TYPE. A null check returning false is required.

findings.title: getResourceName does not resolve Groups resources
findings.body: File AdminPermissionsSchema.java getResourceName() special-cases only USERS to return username or All users, otherwise returns resource.getDisplayName(). Group resources created by getOrCreateResource() are named by group id with no displayName set, so group permissions UI/API shows raw UUIDs or null instead of group name/path. The new Groups type needs the same resolution as users via session.groups().getGroupById().
